headline: UK Government to Expand Live Facial Recognition at Transport Hubs
summary: The UK government plans to deploy expanded live facial recognition systems at public events and transport hubs. The technology deployment targets enforcement of immigration compliance.
why: Government technology contracts and biometric monitoring rules affect security technology vendors and public transit operators.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: Increased biometric monitoring implementation expands law enforcement oversight at transport hubs.
